fields.name: Capture_ID
fields.description: Stable source-capture row identifier.

fields.name: Object_ID
fields.description: Workbook object identifier or source designation.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Human-readable body name.

fields.name: Capture_Source
fields.description: Source authority or capture route, initially JPL SBDB.

fields.name: Capture_Type
fields.description: Payload category such as object payload first or strategic tag-case source-gate.

fields.name: Scenario_Window
fields.description: Scenario branch coverage, e.g. all three start windows.

fields.name: Source_URL
fields.description: Source route URL used for capture.

fields.name: Capture_Window_Duration
fields.description: Time window description for pre-pull, payload pull, and post-pull comparison.

fields.name: Payload_Status
fields.description: Current payload capture state.

fields.name: Captured_Fields
fields.description: Fields expected or captured from source payload.

fields.name: Conflicting_Values
fields.description: Conflicting values found between source payload and workbook fields.

fields.name: Workbook_Source_Range
fields.description: Workbook range used as current baseline.

fields.name: Candidate_Range
fields.description: Candidate/source-gate row range.

fields.name: Canon_Update_Policy
fields.description: Compare-first and conflict-log policy before canon update.

fields.name: Cognigrex_Action
fields.description: Automated or review action routed to Cognigrex.

fields.name: Appendix_Log_Range
fields.description: Appendix & Log row range for traceability.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Current row state.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Operator or automation notes.

fields.name: Date_Created
fields.description: Workbook row creation date.

fields.name: Publish_Queue_Link
fields.description: Publish Review Queue link range.

fields.name: Safety_Label
fields.description: Safety/context label for the object row.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Capture priority.

guardrails: External payloads compare against workbook values before canon updates.
Conflicts are recorded in Conflicting_Values and Appendix & Log.
Schema supports data operations and review outputs only.
